handoff: Not done: the English starter kata set (ticket work item 5). PJR-BXYM is still in progress and the set is undecided. After BXYM is settled, translate the kata into `docs/en/specdojo/{rulebooks,recipes,samples,templates}/` with the same file names and ids, and add `specdojo.translated_from` (`locale: ja`, plus the commit that last changed the Japanese file).
To ship English kata in the npm package, add `docs/en/specdojo` (excluding `generated`) to `files` in `package.json`. This is protected configuration, so it was not changed.

Implementation is a separate item: `kata_locale` (top level of `.specdojo/specdojo.config.json`, `ja`/`en`, default `ja`, falls back to `ja` when the English version is missing), the `init` question `Kata language (ja / en) [ja]:` and `--kata-locale`, and a `LOCALE` column at the end of `kata list` (`ja (fallback)` on fallback). Suggest filing it as its own register item.
_UNDECIDED_: whether the `init` default follows the OS language (`LANG`), and whether orchestrator and CLI messages switch language with the same key. Both need the user's decision.

The completion criteria require `npm run docs:build`. It rewrites `.specdojo/doc-index.json`, so the executor could not run it. The orchestrator should run it on the host and confirm that the `docs/en/` pages (English Quick Start and entry page) build.
Since `.remarkrc.yaml` now runs the guide frontmatter schema on `docs/en/specdojo/guides/**/*.md`, check that the parent `lint:fm` passes for the English Quick Start (including `translated_from`).
